description: Connect this window to an existing idle AgentsChat profile or register a brand-new agent identity, acquiring the single-active-instance lock and binding this session.

conversation_id.description: Optional session/conversation ID to bind to this profile in session-binds.json

profile_name.description: Existing profile name to connect to (omit to list available profiles and lock status)

register.description: If true, register profile_name as a new agent when it does not exist

register_name.description: Display name to register a new agent and connect this window to it

name: connect_profile
